## Min-Max [0,1] normalization of arcsinh-transformed counts
```{r}
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs"))
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "min_max") / (rowMaxs(assay(sce, "exprs")) - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs")))

```

# 1. a) perform GMM

## threshold & GMM
```{r GMM-threshold, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)
type_markers <- c("CA9","panCK","CD31/vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD45RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
rowData(sce)$type_markers <- rownames(sce) %in% type_markers

# paste TRUE for pos and FALSE for neg

out_list <- foreach(x = type_markers) %dopar% { 
  GMM_marker <- Mclust(assay(sce, "exprs")[x,], G = 2)
  GMM_df <- data.frame(
    class_marker = ifelse(GMM_marker$classification == 2 & GMM_marker$uncertainty == 0, TRUE, FALSE),
    marker_exprs = assay(sce, "exprs")[x,],
    uncertainty = GMM_marker$uncertainty
  )
  
  t1 <- GMM_df %>% filter(class_marker == FALSE) %>% arrange(marker_exprs) %>% tail(1) %>% pull(marker_exprs)
  t2 <- GMM_df %>% filter(class_marker == TRUE) %>% arrange(marker_exprs) %>% head(1) %>% pull(marker_exprs)
  threshold <- (t1 + t2) / 2

  list(data = GMM_df, threshold = threshold)
}

# Extract thresholds for further use
thresholds <- sapply(out_list, function(x) x$threshold)

# Update the colData in sce
for (i in seq_along(type_markers)) {
  colData(sce)[, paste0(type_markers[i], "_GMM")] <- out_list[[i]]$data$class_marker
}

```

## Plot

```{r GMM-threshold-plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, chache=TRUE}
library(gridExtra)
library(mclust)

type_markers <- c("CA9","panCK","CD31/vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD45RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")

plot_list <- list() 

for (i in seq_along(type_markers)) {
  marker <- type_markers[i]
  GMM_df <- out_list[[i]]$data
  threshold <- out_list[[i]]$threshold

  # Plot
  plot <- ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = marker_exprs)) +
    geom_density() +
    geom_rug(aes(color = class_marker)) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    ggtitle(paste("Type Marker:", marker, "\nThreshold:", threshold)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#89ABE3", "FALSE" = "#EA738D"))
  
  ## Save plots in plot_list
  plot_list[[marker]] <- plot
    
  ## Save plots as indiv pdfs
  if(marker == "CD31/vWF"){marker <- "CD31_vWF"}
  pdf(paste0("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/Figures/GMM/GMM_", marker, ".pdf"),width = 6,height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}

combined_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 5, labels = "AUTO")

```

Combine GMM scores into a single type score (separate for epithelial and non-epithelial cells)
```{r GMM-type-score-non-epithelial, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)

## For non_epithelial cells  

# change "CD31/vWF_GMM" to "CD31_vWF_GMM" in colData
colData(sce)$CD31_vWF_GMM <- colData(sce)$"CD31/vWF_GMM"
colData(sce)$"CD31/vWF_GMM" <- NULL
type_markers <- c("CA9","panCK","CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD45RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
type_markers <- paste(type_markers, "_GMM", sep="")

# Convert the data.frame to a data.table
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select("cell_id", "CD31_vWF_GMM","SMA_GMM","CD45RO_GMM", "CD45RA_GMM", "CD3_GMM","CD4_GMM","CD8a_GMM","CD38_GMM","MPO_GMM","CD11c_GMM","CD20_GMM", "CD68_GMM") %>% as.data.table()

string_to_detect <- "TRUE"

# Detect pos across columns
data_dt[, Contains_String := apply(.SD, 1, function(x) any(str_detect(x, string_to_detect))), .SDcols = -"cell_id"]

#Add to sce
sce$non_epithelial_GMM <- data_dt$Contains_String[match(sce$cell_id, data_dt$cell_id)]

```


```{r GMM-type-score_epithelial, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)

## For epithelial cells

string_to_detect <- "TRUE"

# Detect pos across columns
data_dt[, Contains_String := apply(.SD, 1, function(x) any(str_detect(x, string_to_detect))), .SDcols = -"cell_id"]

#Add to sce
sce$epithelial_GMM <- data_dt$Contains_String[match(sce$cell_id, data_dt$cell_id)]
```

### FlowSOM

```{r}
library(CATALYST)

rowData(sce)$broad_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CA9","panCK","CD31/vWF","SMA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68", "CD45RO", "CD45RA")

# Run FlowSOM and ConsensusClusterPlus clustering
set.seed(220410)
sce <- CATALYST::cluster(sce,
                         features = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$broad_cluster],
                         maxK = 30)

# Assess cluster stability
# opptimal k at which plateau is reached
delta_area(sce)

delta_area(sce)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,0.01), xlim = c(4, 25))

# saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_04_ccRCC.rds")
```

#### Cluster stability testing and comparison
```{r}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]

sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_04_ccRCC.rds")

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_[:digit:]")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,2]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "cluster")
}



p_n_clus <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$k), max(df$k), by = 1),1)

p_rmsd_FS <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$k), max(df$k), by = 1))+
  labs(x="num_clus", y="RMSD")

p_sil_FS <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$k), max(df$k), by = 1))+
  labs(x="num_clus", y="silhouette width")
  
p_n_clus+p_rmsd_FS+p_sil_FS

# the bigger the sil the better
# the smaller the rmsd the better (consisency/homogeinty within clusters)

# clusters to test (highest sil compared to neighboring clusters)
# 11, 13, 14, 19, 23
```

#### UMAP
run UMAP
```{r}
# run UMAP on subset to save time

set.seed(2024)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub]
sce_sub2 <- sce[,sub]

# use broad_cluster as markers
sce_sub <- runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$broad_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 5,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
```

## 1. c) Astir for automated cell type assignment 

### Astir model

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

```{r astir-expo}
#Export arsinh normalized expression matrix as csv
expr_astir <- assay(sce,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce$PID)

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/expr_ccRCC_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Export design matrix 
design_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID)

write.csv(design_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/design_ccRCC_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```


`Next: Run Astir in Python.`


```{r astir-ana, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Import Astir cell type assignments
astir_type <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/astir_ccRCC_celltypes_TME.csv",col_names = c("ID","cell_type"),skip = 1)

astir_sum <- astir_type %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% dplyr::count()


# Add to sce
sce$astir_type <- astir_type$cell_type[match(sce$cell_id, astir_type$ID)]

# Create combined category
sce$astir_combined <- ifelse(sce$astir_type %in% c("Unknown","Other"), "Unknown/Other", ifelse(sce$astir_type == "Tumor", "Epithelial", "Non-Epithelial"))

#Mark channels used for cell type assignment 
astir_channel = c("CD3","CD4","CD8a", "CD68", "CD11c", "MPO", "CD31/vWF", "SMA", "CD38", "CA9", "panCK")

rowData(sce)$use_astir <- rowData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(use_astir = ifelse(rownames(sce) %in% astir_channel,TRUE,FALSE)) %>% pull(use_astir)
```

overview of markers used for each classification
```{r}
rowData(sce)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(type_markers, # GMM
                broad_cluster, # SOM
                use_astir) # astir

mat <- rowData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(type_markers, broad_cluster, use_astir) %>%
  mutate_all(~ as.integer(.)) %>% 
  filter(type_markers == 1)

colnames(mat) <- c("GMM", "FlowSOM", "Astir")
```

# 2. Combine results

cluster_19 and cluster_23 showed the best results so far but can still be improved (slight preference for 23). Cluster_19 shows a lot more immune cells than cluster_23. All other cluster sizes tested assigned way too many cells as tumor (> 8'000).


## Heatmap of clusters with GMM and ASTIR information

### Cluster Categories

```{r}

### 1. Heatmap body ###


# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
# We select cluster_23
sce$cluster <- sce$cluster_23
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$broad_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Add number of neighbors to sce object (saved in ColPair)
n_neighbors <- colPair(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(from) %>% dplyr::count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
sce$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors$n[match(seq_along(colnames(sce)),n_neighbors$from)]
sce$n_neighbors <- sce$n_neighbors %>% replace_na(0)

#Select spatial features and average over clusters 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-cluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster = spatial$cluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Metadata features

#Number of cells per cluster 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster, ncells)

#GMM - non-epithelial GMM
nr_immune <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster, non_epithelial_GMM) %>% table()
fr_immune <- as.data.frame(nr_immune) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = non_epithelial_GMM, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")
fr_immune <- fr_immune %>% transmute(fr_immune = `TRUE`/rowSums(fr_immune)) %>% as.data.frame()

#Astir - non-epithelial prediction
nr_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster, astir_combined) %>% table()
fr_astir <- as.data.frame(nr_astir) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = astir_combined, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")
fr_astir <- fr_astir %>% dplyr::select(-"Unknown/Other") %>% transmute(fr_astir = `Non-Epithelial`/rowSums(fr_astir)) %>% as.data.frame()


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(GMM_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_immune, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            Astir_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_astir, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "black", col = 1)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")
### 3. Define tumor, mixed and stroma cluster (based on GMM_CK)
#### This step is highly important for downstream categories 

# Here we manually set the cut-off (other options that were tried are tertiles/GMM)
anno_cluscat <- fr_astir %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(cluster_category = ifelse(fr_astir >= 0.5,"Non-Epithelial",ifelse(fr_astir < 0.5 & fr_astir > 0.1,"Mixed","Epithelial")))


# Set colors for clusters and cluster_category then add to metdata
cluster_col <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"))(length(unique(anno_cluscat$cluster))),unique(anno_cluscat$cluster))
cluster_category <- setNames(c("#1F78B4", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A"),sort(unique(anno_cluscat$cluster_category)))                                  
metadata(sce)$colors$cluster <- cluster_col           
metadata(sce)$colors$cluster_category <- cluster_category               

#Visualize GMM_panCK density plots
plot_astir_density <- ggplot(anno_cluscat, aes(fr_astir))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = cluster_category))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "red3")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, color = "red3")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_category)

ha_cluscat <- HeatmapAnnotation(cluster_category = anno_cluscat$cluster_category,
                                col = list(cluster_category = metadata(sce)$colors$cluster_category),
                                border = TRUE,
                                which = "row")


### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h_combined_mixed <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = col_main,
        name= "min_max",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, row_split = anno_cluscat$cluster_category,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        left_annotation = ha_cluscat)+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))),
        name= "min_max",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, row_split = anno_cluscat$cluster_category,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

draw(h_combined_mixed)

### Add cluster_categories to sce
sce$cluster_category_23 <- anno_cluscat$cluster_category[match(sce$cluster,anno_cluscat$cluster)]
```

# 3. Quality control

## Dimensionality Reduction
#### UMAP
run UMAP
```{r}
# run UMAP on subset to save time

set.seed(2024)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub]
sce_sub2 <- sce[,sub]

# use broad_cluster as markers
sce_sub <- runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$broad_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 2,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
sce_sub2 <- runUMAP(sce_sub2[rowData(sce_sub2)$broad_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 5,exprs_values = "min_max", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
```

```{r}
        scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$analysis_cat)

# on min_max
UMAP_analysis_cat_minmax <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub2, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "analysis_cat") +
        scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$analysis_cat)
```

## Marker expression between Tumot/Non-Tumor

```{r}
library(ggridges)
use_markers <- c("CA9", "panCK", "SMA", "CD8a", "CD68", "CD45RA", "CD4", "Vim")

# Funciton to exptract exprs
extract_exprs <- function(sce, cat, use_markers){
  cur_sce <- sce[, sce$analyisis_cat == cat]
  cur_df <- t(unname(assay(cur_sce, "min_max")[use_markers,]))
  cur_df <- as.data.frame(cur_df)
  colnames(cur_df) <- use_markers
  cur_df <- cur_df %>% rownames_to_column("Sample") %>% pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Marker", values_to = "min_max")
  cur_df$Condition <- cat
  return(cur_df)
}

all_dfs <- lapply(unique(sce$analyisis_cat), function(celltype) {
  extract_exprs(sce, celltype, use_markers)
})

final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_dfs)

# plot
marker_distribution <- ggplot(final_df, aes(x = min_max, y = Marker, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 5) + 
  xlim(c(0, 1)) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$analyisis_cat)
```

## Differential expression analysis 

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

type_markers <- c("CA9","panCK","CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD20", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")

# 1. Aggregate expression per PID and category 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce,
                                 ids = DataFrame(sce$PID, sce$analysis_cat),
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs")


# 2. Calculate log2FC 
## Aggregate per category 
mean_sce_1 <- aggregateAcrossCells(mean_sce, 
                     ids = mean_sce$sce.analysis_cat, 
                     statistics = "mean",
                     use.assay.type = "exprs")

logFC <- log2(assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.analysis_cat == "tumor"]/assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.analysis_cat == "non_tumor"])

# 3. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
exprs <- as.data.frame(t(assay(mean_sce)))

exprs$analysis_cat <- mean_sce$analysis_cat

p_value <- c()
for (i in 1:(length(colnames(exprs))-1)) {
  t <- t.test(exprs[exprs$analysis_cat == "tumor",i], exprs[exprs$analysis_cat == "non_tumor",i])
  p_value[i] <- t$p.value
}
## Adjust p.value 
p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(exprs)[1:43]

# 4. Plot VolcanoPlot 
data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value_adj))
data <- data[which(rownames(data) %in% type_markers),]

keyvals <- ifelse(
   data$logFC < -0.58, "#E41A1C",
      ifelse(data$logFC > 0.58, "#377EB8",
        'black'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- 'High TME'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Tumor'
  
EnhancedVolcano(data,
    lab = rownames(data),
    x = 'logFC',
    y = 'p_value_adj',
    title = 'Tumor and non-tumor cells',
    boxedLabels = TRUE,
    pCutoff = 0.0001,
    FCcutoff = 0.58,
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    pointSize = 8.0,
    labSize = 8.0, 
    colCustom = keyvals)
```

```{r}
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
```

## CATALYST-based visualization

MDS pseudobulk - MultiDimensional Scaling Pseudobulkk Analysis:
- Dimensionality reduction based on pseudobulk (Data aggregation within cell types) rather than on single cell level 
- MDS aims to represent the data in a lower-dimensional space while preserving the pairwise distances (or dissimilarities) between data points as accurately as possible

clrDR:
- Computes centered log-ratios on cluster/sample proportions across samples/clusters, and visualizes them in a lower-dimensional space (linear!), highlighting differences in composition between samples/clusters.
- PCA performed on clr transformed data


We will first convert the sce into a CATALYST-compatible format.

```{r CATALYST}
library(CATALYST)
# save spe in CATALYST-compatible object with renamed colData entries and 
# new metadata information
sce_cat <- sce 
sce_cat$sample_id <- factor(sce$PID)
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$analysis_cat)

#add celltype information to metadata
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(analysis_cat = factor(sce_cat$analysis_cat))
```

```{r CATALYST pbmds and clrDR, message=FALSE}
# MDS pseudobulk 
## by analysis_cat
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$broad_cluster],
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "analysis_cat") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$analysis_cat)+
  theme_classic()


# CLR of patient proportions per myeloid_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "analysis_cat", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$analysis_cat, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()


# CLR of immune_metacluster proportions per patient
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "sample_id", point_col = "sample_id",
      k = "analysis_cat", point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$analysis_cat)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_classic()
```


### Tumor cells 

```{r}
# 1. Tumor cells only 
# Define PDL1 positivity by GMM
set.seed(22)
sce_tumor <- sce[,sce$analysis_cat == "tumor"] 

# CD274
GMM_CD274 <- Mclust(assay(sce_tumor, "exprs")["CD274",], G = 2)


GMM_df <- data.frame(class_PDL1 = ifelse(GMM_CD274$classification == 2 & GMM_CD274$uncertainty == 0, 
                                        "CD274+",
                                        "CD274-"), 
                     CD274_exprs = assay(sce_tumor, "exprs")["CD274",],
                     uncertainty = GMM_CD274$uncertainty)

# Define PDL1 positivity by exprs > 1 
GMM_df$class_PDL1_1 <- ifelse(GMM_df$CD274_exprs > 1, "CD274+", "CD274-") 

cut_off_GMM <- mean((GMM_df %>% filter(class_PDL1 == "CD274+") %>% arrange(CD274_exprs) %>% pull(CD274_exprs))[1],
(GMM_df %>% filter(class_PDL1 == "CD274-") %>% arrange(desc(CD274_exprs)) %>% pull(CD274_exprs))[1])

# Visualize manual cut off
ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = CD274_exprs, fill = class_PDL1_1))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = class_PDL1_1))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

#Visualize GMM
ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = CD274_exprs, fill = class_PDL1))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = class_PDL1))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# Add PDL1 group 
sce_tumor$tumor_CD274_GMM <- GMM_df$class_PDL1[match(colnames(sce_tumor), rownames(GMM_df))]
sce_tumor$tumor_CD274_1 <- GMM_df$class_PDL1_1[match(colnames(sce_tumor), rownames(GMM_df))]


n_cat <- colData(sce_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(tumor_CD274_1) %>% count()
n_cat <- n_cat %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% mutate(fra = (n/sum)*100)
n_cat
```

```{r}

cur_PID_out <- cur_PID %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) %>% filter(tumor_CD274_GMM == "CD274+" & fra >= 0.01) %>% arrange(desc(fra)) %>% pull(PID) %>% unfactor()
```

### cytoviewer visualization

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/masks_ccRCC")
```

```{r}
# Select images
cur_PID <- colData(sce_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tumor_CD274_GMM,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
cur_PID <- unfactor(cur_PID %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) %>% filter(tumor_CD274_GMM == "CD274+" & fra > 0.1) %>% arrange(desc(fra)) %>% pull(PID))[1:10]
  
cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, sample_id) %>% filter(PID %in%cur_PID) %>% pull(sample_id) %>% unique())

cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
```


```{r}
library(cytoviewer)
cytoviewer(image = getChannels(cur_images, rownames(cur_sce)), mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, img_id = "sample_id", cell_id = "ObjectNumber")
```


### Decision for PDL1 cutoff 

We will use the GMM-based combined positive score (CPS) for downstream analysis.

```{r}
# Cell based score
sce$PDL1_score_cells <- sce_all$all_CD274_GMM[match(sce$cell_id, sce_all$cell_id)]

# Patient based score
sce$PDL1_score <- sce$PDL1_score_all_GMM_1[match(sce$PID, sce_all$PID)]
sce$PDL1_score <- ifelse(sce$PDL1_score == "PDL1_pos","1","0")
```

```{r}
# Set colors 
metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score <- setNames(c("#00441B","#AADBAB"),unique(sce$PDL1_score))
metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score_cells <- setNames(c("#AADBAB","#00441B"),unique(sce$PDL1_score_cells))
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

cur_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, analysis_cat) %>% group_by(PID,analysis_cat) %>% summarise(n= n())
cur_df <- cur_df %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = analysis_cat, values_from = n)
cur_df <- cur_df %>% mutate(proportion = tumor/(tumor+non_tumor))

sce$prop_tumor_non_tumor_PID <- cur_df$proportion[match(sce$PID, cur_df$PID)]

cur_df <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, prop_tumor_non_tumor_PID, PDL1_score) %>% group_by(PID) %>% slice(1) %>%  ungroup()

# Replace NA with "Unknown" to access colors in metadata
cur_df$PDL1_score[is.na(cur_df$PDL1_score)] <- "Unknown"

# Convert df columns into a factor with explicit levels including "Unknown"
cur_df$PDL1_score <- factor(cur_df$PDL1_score, levels = c(0, 1, "Unknown"))

# PDL1_score
tumor_prop_PDL1 <- ggplot(data = cur_df %>% filter(PDL1_score != "Unknown"), 
       aes(x = PDL1_score, y = prop_tumor_non_tumor_PID, fill = PDL1_score)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score)+
  labs(x = "status",
       y = "Tumor/Non-Tumor") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )+
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test")
```
